languages/powershell.ruleContract: no numbered normative rule headings matching <PREFIX>-NNN were published in v0.10.0; additive candidate changes must not create a claim that a removed published numbered rule existed

rules.CSHARP-LANG-001: Resolve the selected SDK/compiler and use a stable language version supported by the declared target; `latest` and unapproved preview settings are prohibited.
rules.CSHARP-NULL-002: Nullable annotations and flow analysis must express the real contract; suppression requires a narrow, reviewable invariant.
rules.CSHARP-ASYNC-003: Asynchronous and concurrent code must propagate cancellation, avoid sync-over-async, bound concurrency, and define ownership of started work.
rules.CSHARP-API-004: Public APIs, serialized shapes, generic constraints, default values, exception behavior, and binary/source compatibility must change only through reviewed versioning and migration decisions.
rules.CSHARP-RESOURCE-005: Code must distinguish owned from borrowed resources and deterministically release owned synchronous and asynchronous resources on success, failure, and cancellation.
rules.CSHARP-SEC-006: C# code must validate trust boundaries and must not use insecure deserialization, command construction, path handling, cryptography, certificate bypass, or secret exposure as implementation shortcuts.
rules.CSHARP-TOOL-007: Build, analyzer, formatter, generator, scripting-host, and dependency versions must be reproducible and reviewed; operational execution must not silently acquire floating code.
rules.CSHARP-TEST-008: Tests must cover externally meaningful normal, boundary, invalid, cancellation, failure, concurrency, cleanup, and compatibility behavior appropriate to the change.
rules.CSHARP-INTEROP-009: Reflection, `dynamic`, expression compilation, source generation, native interop, and unsafe code require a documented boundary, minimized scope, validation, and fallback or failure behavior.
rules.CSHARP-EVIDENCE-010: Completion claims must identify the exact source and contracts changed, resolved compiler boundary, validation results, unavailable checks, and remaining limitations.

coverageRule: Every candidate Markdown heading matching ^### [A-Z][A-Z0-9-]*-[0-9]{3}$ must be inside an unchanged published v0.10.0 rule tree or an explicitly versioned changed-source contract above.
